title: Target-Constrained Pooling for Trajectory Extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13034v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trajectory extrapolation from a partial target trajectory is underdetermined, but completed related trajectories provide information about the unresolved continuation. We propose target-constrained pooling (TCP), which separates the finite-horizon endpoint from continuation shape and estimates that endpoint from two complementary source signals. Uniform pooling captures final response levels, while matched-increment pooling captures the remaining change after aligning source and target states. TCP selects representative sources, projects both endpoint estimates onto a target-consistent region, converts them into corrections of the free forecast, and controls their influence through strength calibration and degradation-aware weighting. Across 25,245 targets from five domains and both forecasting directions, TCP reduces mean RMSE by 35.8% to 42.1% for all ten target-only forecasters and improves all 100 forecaster, dataset, and direction c

translated_title: 面向轨迹外推的目标约束池化
translated_abstract: 从部分目标轨迹进行轨迹外推是一个欠定问题，但已完成的相关轨迹能提供有关未确定延续部分的信息。我们提出了目标约束池化（TCP），该方法将有界时间范围的终点与延续形态分离，并从两个互补的源信号中估计该终点。均匀池化捕捉最终响应水平，而匹配增量池化在对齐源与目标状态后捕捉剩余变化。TCP选择代表性源，将两个终点估计投影到与目标一致的区域，将其转化为对自由预测的修正，并通过强度校准和退化感知加权来控制其影响。在来自五个领域、涵盖两个预测方向的25,245个目标上，TCP使所有十个仅基于目标的预测器的平均RMSE降低了35.8%至42.1%，并改进了全部100个预测器、数据集与方向的组合。
tldr: 提出目标约束池化（TCP）方法，利用已完成的相关轨迹从两种互补池化信号中估计轨迹终点并修正自由预测，在五个领域的25,245个目标上将平均RMSE降低35.8%至42.1%。
en_tdlr: Proposes Target-Constrained Pooling (TCP), which estimates trajectory endpoints from two complementary pooling signals in completed related trajectories to correct free forecasts, reducing mean RMSE by 35.8%–42.1% across 25,245 targets from five domains.
